reference_sql:
WITH by_channel AS (
  -- one row per parent category with sales in 2025
  SELECT parent_category,
    SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS store_revenue_eur,
    SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS web_revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY parent_category
)
SELECT parent_category, store_revenue_eur, web_revenue_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * web_revenue_eur / (store_revenue_eur + web_revenue_eur), 1) AS web_share_pct
FROM by_channel
